---
title: "IAM NAB Correlation"
output: html_notebook
---


Load required libraries.
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ppcor)
```


Initialization.
```{r}
df_long <- read.csv("/Volumes/vdrive/helpern_users/aghamoosa_s/01_Research_Projects/IAM_network_amyloid/IAM_NAB_long.csv")

#convert to wide
df_wide <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::select(studyid, age, pet_read, Cer_avg, Nets_msuvr_avg, Network, Amyloid, gencomp_adjz, Non.Cognitive, Cognitive) %>%   # keep only these columns
  pivot_wider(names_from = Network, values_from = Amyloid)



```


##Correlations

Partial spearman
```{r}

df_corr <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(Cognitive, gencomp_adjz, age) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()   # removes any rows with NA in these columns


pcor.test(df_corr$Cognitive,df_corr$gencomp_adjz, df_corr$age, method="spearman")


```


Plot
```{r}
# 1) Compute partial Spearman correlation (matches your call)
pc <- pcor.test(df_corr$Cognitive, df_corr$gencomp_adjz, df_corr$age, method = "spearman")

# 2) Create a data frame with ranks and residualize on rank(age)
df_plot <- df_corr %>%
  transmute(
    cog_rank  = rank(Cognitive, ties.method = "average"),
    gen_rank  = rank(gencomp_adjz, ties.method = "average"),
    age_rank  = rank(age, ties.method = "average")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # residuals from regressing cog_rank on age_rank
    cog_resid = resid(lm(cog_rank ~ age_rank)),
    # residuals from regressing gen_rank on age_rank
    gen_resid = resid(lm(gen_rank ~ age_rank))
  )

# 3) Plot residuals vs residuals with a linear fit and annotate rho, p
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = gen_resid, y = cog_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  labs(
    x = "General Cognition Composite (residualized on age; rank scale)",
    y = "Cognitive NAB (residualized on age; rank scale)",
    title = "Partial Spearman Relationship: Cognitive vs gencomp_adjz (controlling for age)",
    subtitle = paste0("Partial Spearman ρ = ",
                      round(pc$estimate, 3),
                      ", p = ", format.pval(pc$p.value, digits = 3))
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
